verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server (MCP.md, verified by probe) enabling agents like Claude to read threads, ask questions about mailbox content, compose with AI assistance, and create/send drafts and new emails, plus manage labels — covering triage, drafting, and sending end to end via Better Auth session token auth. missing for 10: no hands-on third-party report of an external agent (Claude/ChatGPT) actually completing a full read-triage-send workflow, and OAuth support is still 'coming soon' rather than shipped.
